message: As we explore the joys of preparedness, it's refreshing to rediscover some low-tech skills that can connect us with our families and our surroundings. The resource we found offers practical insights into safety skills that are not only useful but also fun to learn together. Whether it's practicing basic first aid or mastering fire safety, these activities can turn into memorable moments with our loved ones. Let's embrace the simple joys of learning and being ready, one skill at a time. What’s a fun safety skill you’d love to try together? 😊
